FAQs On Hiring Skilled Salesforce Developers 

How much does it cost to hire a Salesforce developer?

The cost depends on the county where your Salesforce expert is based, their experience, and the demand for such a Salesforce developer in the local labor market. Book a free consultation to estimate the cost of your hires. 

How much time does it take to develop a custom Salesforce application?

The development time ranges from several weeks to several months, depending on how complex your customization requirements are. Mobilunity’s Salesforce engineers will estimate and follow optimized time frames for each stage of your product development cycle and ensure timely project delivery.

Do you help with technical interviews?

Sure, Mobilunity offers technical interviews as a service to verify if your candidates have the hard and soft skills required for your project. You get a report for each assessed applicant to take only top Salesforce developers on board. 

Do you develop customized Salesforce solutions?

Mobilunity is not a custom software development company. Instead, we have access to a diverse range of Salesforce developers with comprehensive knowledge of the Salesforce ecosystem. So no matter the industry, company size, or specific workflows, our tech masters can tailor Salesforce software to your business needs with declarative tools, app integrations, and custom development. 

How does hiring a Salesforce contractor compare to having in-house developers?

Engaging a Salesforce contractor provides flexibility, allowing you to bring in an expert for a specific project without long-term commitments. Contractors often work with diverse clients and industries, giving them broad experience and the ability to quickly adapt to the unique requirements of your project. This approach also allows for better cost control, as you only pay for services during the period needed to complete the task.
In-house developers, on the other hand, become a part of your team, gaining a deeper understanding of your internal processes and focusing on the company’s long-term goals. They provide stability and continuity, which is especially important for long-term projects or ongoing support. However, investment in an internal team involves recruiting, onboarding, and continuous development of specialists.
The choice between a Salesforce contractor and in-house developers depends on project duration, budget, and required skills. Both options can be effective, but each has its own advantages for different business goals.

What should I consider when hiring dedicated Salesforce developers from a provider?

Consider the vendor’s years in the market and industries served, the number of hired tech experts and successful projects, retention rates, and the percentage of developers who passed probation. Check if this provider offers flexible cooperation, works on talent retention, and focuses on long-term partnerships. 

Which Salesforce services do you provide?

You can hire our Salesforce developers to build custom solutions, integrate Salesforce and third-party apps, or migrate your data. They also offer package development, managed services, maintenance and support, advisory, and other services. 

Which industries do you work in?

Mobilunity can hire certified Salesforce professionals with deep expertise in financial services, retail, healthcare, education, insurance, manufacturing, transportation, hospitality, and many more. 

Can I hire expert Salesforce developers to extend my tech team?

Sure, you can. Once you need Salesforce developers to reinforce your existing team, we’ll study your requirements and company culture to swiftly connect you with the ideal-match developers.
